This is among the corpus's most heavily used references - roughly fifteen Lean -- Ref: sites across QOU/QBeta/*, plus appendix-mass-binding-algorithms and mass-theory prose. SPOT-CHECKS AGAINST THE PDF, all confirmed: eq. (102) is S+_{sigma1,sigma1}(q) = 2 H+_{1,0}(q) H-_{1,0}(q) = 1 - 12q + 3q^2 + 74q^3 + 90q^4 + O(q^5) = Ind_{5_2}(q), exactly as QOU/QBeta/GZWeightGeneral.lean:32 cites it; eqs (96)/(97)/(98) are the 5_2 Stokes matrices and the q -> 0 factorisation of S+(0), as the five 5_2-DT-spectrum sites cite; eq (65) is the Stokes-automorphism relation s+ = S_theta(q~) s-, as StokesSymmetryConstant.lean cites; det(W_m(q)) = 2 is present in the text. *** LOCATOR DEFECT ***: about ten Lean sites spell the citation as '[garoufalidis-gu-marino2021] GGM 2012.00062' - a DIFFERENT arXiv identifier. 2012.00062 is the companion peacock-patterns paper, which the corpus registers separately as garoufalidis-gu-marino2023peacock and cites under that key in mass-theory/stokes-dt-bps-bridge.md. The equation numbers quoted at those sites belong to THIS document, so the mathematics is right and the inline identifier is wrong. Two sites also carry sub-locators I could not resolve here: 'eq 59a sandwich' (there is a (59), no (59a)) and 'Thm 9 det W_m = 2' (the identity is present, but the only numbered theorem in this document is Theorem 3).

keyResults.statement: Explicit 5_2 Stokes matrices S_{II+ -> III+}(q) etc., and the q -> 0 factorisation S+(0) = S_{sigma3,sigma1} S_{sigma3,sigma2} S_{sigma1,sigma2}.
keyResults.useForFolio: The 5_2 DT spectrum the corpus's Stokes-constant files read off; note that S+(0) is eq. (98), not eq. (60) as two sites state.

keyResults.statement: The Stokes automorphism is a pair of matrices of integer q-series determined by fundamental solutions of two linear q-difference equations; a distinguished entry equals the DGG 3d index.
keyResults.useForFolio: The conjectural frame the corpus's GZWeightSelection.lean cites as 'Conj. 2, Stokes = rotated 3d-index' - correctly attributed.
